APIs for querying, preparing, publishing, and verifying funk records.

# Purpose
`fd_funk_rec.h` defines the record data type and record-management API for the funk transaction store. It declares `fd_funk_rec_t`, which holds the transaction/key pair, map links, user data, transaction order links, and record value metadata, and it also defines the alignment, null index value, and compile-time size check for the record object. The file uses the pool and chained-map templates to build `fd_funk_rec_pool` and `fd_funk_rec_map`, which support record lookup by `(xid,key)` and record allocation in shared memory. It also declares functions to query records, prepare a new record, publish a prepared record, and verify the record map, with support for both local transaction lookup and ancestor lookup.
